body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code. For private vulnerability reports, please follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md). Related earlier reports: #4044 (pip-audit output about a dependency) and #3088 (a request to support a newer Pygments version).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
